cases.case_label: Retrotransposon at GNAS locus (maternal) in PHP1B
cases.mechanism_detail: A maternally inherited retrotransposon insertion at chr20:58,863,683 in a familial PHP1B case is associated with marked loss of methylation at the GNAS A/B-DMR and mild hypomethylation of AS1-, AS2- and XL-DMRs (an imprinting/methylation defect rather than silencing).
cases.quote: The case with retrotransposon insertion (chr20:58,863,683) showed markedly hypomethylated A/B-DMR, plus mild hypomethylation of the AS1-DMR, AS2-DMR, and XL-DMR
